import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (likely data entry errors)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Fix body mass out of range (5700000 is likely 5700)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    
    # Standardize sex column (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace({'FEMALE': 'female'})
    
    # Drop rows with missing species (none in this case, but safe to include)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species'])
    
    return df


def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average flipper length
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    
    # Return as dict with species as keys
    return result
